content_lines: Status: PROPOSED, not filed authority until ratified.
Owner: Brian. Builder: Codex. Verifier: OPEN.
Purpose: Govern immutable reusable medical question revisions, source lineage, review, releases, and channel artifacts for STAT, Drills, and future consumers.
Protected dependencies: STAT, Drills, Daily Drills, Arena, MissionMed HQ, auth/session, RANKLISTIQ Supabase, media registry, Stream, R2/CDN, and student data.

Hard gates: no source inventory without privacy ownership and authorization; no medical approval without a verified physician assignment; no student release without exact-revision physician approval; no consumer cutover without sealed-pack, rollback, and canary proof.
